scope: All 263 current Player V2 sprite and FX PNGs, excluding raw generation sources; 204 referenced by clips.

sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, texture unification of existing game sprite frames. FIRST image is the exact target: SIXTEEN existing sprites in an evenly spaced 4 by 4 grid. Preserve all 16 cells, all existing poses, frame ordering, weapons, arms, faces, heads, legs and scale EXACTLY. ONLY REPAINT THEIR BACKPACK EXHAUST. SECOND image is the user's APPROVED diagonal exhaust: MATCH its soft compact white tuft texture, bright white core, restrained light-grey shading, slightly irregular rounded/tapered silhouette, no dark outline, no cyan border, no sharp geometric triangles or solid white cutout stickers. Every target sprite must have the same exhaust material/style as reference 2. Replace ALL existing jets; do not stack new jets on top of old ones. Exhaust is generated directly at lower nozzles of the WHITE BACKPACK, integrated with the bag, flowing generally toward the legs along the torso tilt. Two short jets, near and far, far tip at least partly visible where perspective allows. NO boot/foot thrusters, no sparks, no standalone particles, no weapon flashes. Fix jets that presently point off sideways or look like detached triangles. Keep the original character pixels and perspective as close as possible; do not add limbs or redesign anything. All 16 sprites complete, same registration inside original 4x4 cells; truly transparent background, no text/labels/ground/shadows. Repaint connected backpack-to-gas transition, never paste one identical FX stamp onto every pose.

Edit the FIRST attached 4x4 sprite atlas. Preserve ALL 16 astronaut poses, the exact transparent cell registration, black/white outfit, gun, helmet, limbs, facing and action frame poses. ONLY redraw the backpack exhaust. Every single one of the 16 sprites MUST have visible short soft WHITE exhaust BELOW THE BACKPACK, including every RIGHT-FACING sprite in row THREE. On the right-facing sprites the bag is on their LEFT side: show a small compact white tuft directly below that bag, clear of the left boot. Both backpack nozzles emit; the far nozzle can be occluded by the torso but at least a white tip should be visible. Match the beautiful compact soft white tuft with faint neutral-grey edge in reference TWO, do not copy its characters. NO cyan outlines, NO angular pointed triangles, NO foot flames, no detached smoke or extra particles. Each little soft white jet is physically attached to the lower BACKPACK, never boots. Clear visible exhaust in row3 column1 and row3 column3 is essential. Do not omit exhaust from those two cells. Preserve transparent background and original 4x4 atlas layout.

Use case: precise-object-edit. FIRST image is ONE existing backward-lean astronaut. SECOND image is a PINK DIRECTION GUIDE. THIRD image is the exact APPROVED WHITE EXHAUST TEXTURE. Preserve the astronaut body, head, legs, rifle and leaning posture exactly. Replace the old tiny detached triangle jets with two soft natural white exhaust tufts coming DIRECTLY FROM THE TWO BOTTOM NOZZLES OF THE BACKPACK, following the pink lines. This figure faces Left and moves backward: both jets flow diagonally DOWN-LEFT, parallel to the extended legs. Jet tips must be LEFT of their origin on the bag, a / direction. White glowing-gas tufts with compact irregular rounded ends and very light-grey shading like reference3; no black outline, no cyan, no geometric arrowheads, no pasted sharp stickers. Two streams visibly connected to the bag, not hips or boots; far jet may be slightly smaller but show a tip. Remove old jets and every pink mark. Same body size/pose and square framing, actual transparent background, no floor, no muzzle flash or particles.
